newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - December 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - December 9.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Parliamentary Select Committee reaches general consensus on regional borrowing powers under devolution plan to solve ethnic problem.
EPDP leader Douglas Devananda says Tamil people in north face more urgent problems than local government polls.
Gold-plated bed imported by former regime auctioned at 405,000 rupees.
Police planning to tighten restrictions on transport of containers after series of accidents.
Air Force launches inquiry into crash of helicopter carrying Deputy Defence Minister Anuruddha Ratwatte and senior military officers in Tamil rebel territory.
